company_name.description: Legal or trading name of the company.

market_country.description: Country whose market, sources, currency, and regulations the research should use.
market_country.x-ask: Which country is the main market?

document_language.description: Language for the prose. Use the language of the user's request unless they asked for another. Section headings stay as written in template.md.
document_language.x-ask: Which language should the plan be written in?
document_language.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

research_mode.description: web when you opened the cited sources during this fill. offline when you could not browse, so every researched field is an Assumption and sources is empty.
research_mode.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

owner.description: Name from the context or a public source, or the role when no person is named.
owner.x-ask: Whose name should the plan use as owner? Say if you want the role only.

status.description: Draft unless the user said the plan is final.
status.x-ask: What status should this plan show?
status.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

last_updated.description: Date of this fill, in YYYY-MM-DD.
last_updated.x-ask: What date should we use for last updated?
last_updated.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

plan_format.description: traditional. The seven sections stay the same for a lender, an investor, or internal use.
plan_format.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

audience.description: Who will read the plan, inferred from the context.
audience.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

location.description: City or region where the company is based. The country alone is enough when the user has no city.
location.x-ask: Where is the company based? A city is enough. Say if you only know the country.

legal_structure.description: Legal form the user gave, or a public registry filing. If they have not incorporated or do not know, say that and do not invent a filing.
legal_structure.x-ask: What is the legal structure? If it is not incorporated, say so.

executive_summary.description: Short close of the plan: the problem, the offer, the customer, and the funding position. Write it from the other fields.
executive_summary.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

business_concept.description: How the company started and what it does, from the user's context.
business_concept.x-ask: What does the company do, and how did the idea start?

business_model.description: B2C, DTC, B2B, C2C, or C2B, inferred from who pays.
business_model.x-ask: Which business model is this: B2C, DTC, B2B, C2C, or C2B?
business_model.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

industry.description: Industry or niche, with the official classification code when the market country publishes one.
industry.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.

mission.description: Mission written from the context. Do not invent a slogan the user did not imply.
mission.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

values.description: Values implied by the context. Label any value the user did not state as Assumption.
values.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

objectives.description: Objectives for the next year and a later horizon, derived from the context and the forecast.
objectives.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

team.description: People named in the context or a public source. Otherwise the roles the business needs, with no invented names.
team.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

products_and_services.description: What the company sells, from the user's context.
products_and_services.x-ask: What do you sell or plan to offer?

offers.description: One row per offer. Price comes from the user or a cited competitor comparison, labeled Assumption when it is a recommendation.
offers.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

target_customer.description: Who buys, from the user's context.

customer_problem.description: The problem this customer has today, from the context.
customer_problem.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

competitive_advantage.description: How the offer fills a gap the competitors' own pages show.
competitive_advantage.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

market_facts.description: Cited market figures for the target customer and market country.
market_facts.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.

market_analysis.description: Bottom-up market math from the cited figures. Say which inputs are assumptions.
market_analysis.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.

competitors.description: Real competitors with a public page. Do not invent a company.
competitors.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.

strengths.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.
strengths.description: Internal strengths versus the named competitors.

weaknesses.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.
weaknesses.description: Internal weaknesses versus the named competitors.

opportunities.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.
opportunities.description: External opportunities from the market sources.

threats.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.
threats.description: External threats from the market sources and competitors.

marketing_channels.description: Channels, monthly spend, activities, and a measure for each.
marketing_channels.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.

sales_goals.description: Forecast rows. Revenue equals customers times price over the period, and matches financials.series in the same order.
sales_goals.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.

operations_items.description: Suppliers or production, fulfilment or delivery, inventory or hosting, and staff.
operations_items.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.

current_customers.description: Paying customers now. Zero when the user says pre-revenue.
current_customers.x-ask: How many paying customers do you have now? Say zero if you are pre-revenue.

current_revenue.description: Current recurring revenue per month. Zero when the user says pre-revenue.
current_revenue.x-ask: What is current recurring revenue per month? Say zero if you are pre-revenue.

snapshot.description: Other current metrics such as gross margin, churn, acquisition cost, and lifetime value. Label any figure the user did not give as Assumption.
snapshot.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

financials.description: Revenue by period. series matches sales_goals revenue in the same order.
financials.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.

expenses.description: Annual costs for the first forecast year.
expenses.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.

starting_capital.description: Capital available now, from the user. Zero when they have none or do not want a cash figure.
starting_capital.x-ask: How much capital is available to the company now? Say none, or that you do not want a real cash figure.

funding_request.description: Amount requested. Zero when the user is not raising.
funding_request.x-ask: How much funding are you requesting? Say if you are not raising.

use_of_funds.description: How a funding request would be spent. One row that says the company is not raising when funding_request is zero.
use_of_funds.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

assumptions.description: Every estimate, with the cited inputs it uses.
assumptions.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

review_cadence.description: When the plan should be reviewed.
review_cadence.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

sources.description: Public sources used for researched fields. May be empty only when research_mode is offline.
sources.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.
